decision rules.W1: The exact mean equals the product of the knot factors on the unique route.
decision rules.W2: The joint signed sum times the mass equals the product of the two separate signed sums.
decision rules.inside: Each selected distinction has all of its holders in its own knot set.
decision rules.exposed: At least one selected distinction also has a holder outside its own knot set.
decision rules.W2 unit: A pair of products with its unordered pair of nonempty disjoint knot sets.
decision rules.constant term: A product of zero signs is identically one and independent under each weighting.
decision rules.exception records: The archive keeps the first five exceptions per test and weighting. The denominator includes every tested pair.
decision rules.local product check: For each even product, collect the routes from its distinctions to one fixed distinction and cancel repeated places at each knot in pairs. Under the equal weighting its mean is the product of the local factors for knots with a nonempty remainder.
decision rules.joint sizes: At a knot used by both products, size zero records cancellation, size two a two-place product, and size four a four-place product.
